A mini perfume set is a box of small bottles, usually 4ml to 15ml each, from one perfume house. It lets someone try several scents before buying a full bottle, keep a favourite in their bag, or simply enjoy a little collection. Here is what is inside the miniature sets we stock, starting with Jimmy Choo and Dior.

Why choose a mini perfume set?

  • To try before buying: wear each scent for a day or two and see which one you reach for.
  • For travel and handbags: small bottles take up little room.
  • As a gift when you are not sure of their taste: several scents from a house they like is a safer bet than one full bottle.

Sizes vary from set to set, so check the millilitres as well as the number of bottles.

Jimmy Choo mini perfume set

The Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Fragrance Gift Set (£42.99) holds five 4.5ml eau de parfums, 22.5ml in all:

  • I Want Choo: peach and mandarin, red spider lily and jasmine, vanilla.
  • Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum: pear, mandarin and green notes, orchid, toffee and patchouli.
  • I Want Choo Forever: rose and bitter almond, cherry, jasmine and vetiver, vanilla, tonka bean, oakmoss and amber.
  • Rose Passion: frangipani and jasmine, coconut milk and orchid, vanilla and sandalwood.
  • I Want Choo Le Parfum: blackberry, pear and gardenia, jasmine, patchouli and ambrette, praline, sandalwood and moss.

If you already know you love I Want Choo Forever, it also comes as a single 4.5ml miniature (£14.99). See every Jimmy Choo fragrance.

Dior mini perfume set

The Dior Iconics Mini Perfume Discovery Set (£92.99) has five 5ml minis for women and men: J’adore Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Parfum, Miss Dior Eau de Toilette, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Toilette and Sauvage Eau de Toilette. It is the set to choose for someone who loves Dior but whose favourite you do not know. Not sure which Sauvage they wear? Read Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum. More from Dior.

More miniature perfume sets for her

  • Marc Jacobs Miniature Gift Set 2025 (£39.99): Daisy, Daisy Eau So Fresh and Daisy Wild (4ml each) and Perfect (5ml). Fresh fruity florals, plus Perfect’s rhubarb, narcissus and almond milk.
  • Chloé Miniature Perfume Set (£45.99): four 5ml bottles, Chloé Eau de Parfum, Nomade Eau de Parfum and Eau de Toilette, and Rose Tangerine.
  • Gucci Flora Gorgeous Miniature Set (£44.99): three 5ml bottles, Gorgeous Gardenia (pear blossom, gardenia, brown sugar), Gorgeous Magnolia (dewberries, coconut, magnolia) and Gorgeous Orchid (vanilla, vanilla orchid).
  • Mon Guerlain Miniature Set (£44.99): four 5ml bottles, two Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum, Mon Guerlain Florale and Bloom of Rose, all built on lavender and vanilla.
  • DKNY Delicious Miniature Set (£35.99): four 7ml eau de parfums, Be Delicious, Golden Delicious, Be Extra Delicious and Be 100% Delicious.
  • Paco Rabanne Women’s Miniature Set (£50.99): Lady Million, Olympéa, and Fame in two strengths.
  • Calvin Klein Women’s Miniature Set (£33.99): bigger 15ml bottles, two Obsession, one Eternity and one CK One.

Mini aftershave sets for him

  • Paco Rabanne Men’s Miniature Set (£50.99): four 5ml bottles, Phantom, Invictus, 1 Million and 1 Million Elixir.
  • Paco Rabanne Men’s Eau de Toilette Set (£27.99): 1 Million, Invictus and Phantom in 4ml bottles, a smaller and cheaper way to try them.
  • Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set (£34.99): Devotion, K Eau de Toilette, K Eau de Parfum, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme.

For a set anyone can wear, the Hermès Miniature Gift Set (£64.99) holds four 7.5ml unisex scents from the Jardins collection: Un Jardin à Cythère, Un Jardin sur le Nil, Le Jardin de Monsieur Li and Un Jardin sur la Lagune.

Single minis under £20

When one scent is enough, a single miniature makes an easy stocking filler: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 10ml (£18.95), Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Toilette 10ml (£19.99), Versace Eros Pour Femme 5ml (£13.99), Calvin Klein Defy Parfum 10ml (£18.99) and Versace Dylan Blue Pour Homme 5ml (£13.99). A perfume gift set is the easiest way to give someone a scent they already love, with something extra in the box: a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a few miniatures. This guide is our pick of the perfume gift sets in stock for Christmas 2026, sorted by who you are buying for and what you want to spend. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.
  • You know the brand, not the scent: a miniature set lets them try several perfumes from the same house.
  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

Full-bottle sets, from the biggest box down:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£84.99): 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion. A creamy white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Chloé Nomade Gift Set (£66.99): a 75ml eau de parfum and a 20ml travel spray. Mirabelle plum, freesia and oakmoss, a floral chypre that suits the office as well as an evening out.
  • Dolce & Gabbana The One for Women Gift Set (£64.99): two 50ml bottles of a fruity amber floral with peach, lychee, jasmine and vanilla. One for home, one for her bag.
  • Elie Saab Le Parfum Lumière Gift Set (£48.99): 90ml eau de parfum, a 10ml spray and a 75ml body lotion, with orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose.
  • Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Gift Set (£47.99): 50ml eau de parfum with a 50ml body lotion. Lilac, rose and violet over patchouli.
  • Elie Saab Girl of Now Lovely Gift Set (£38.99): 50ml eau de parfum and a 75ml body lotion, a sweeter scent of red berries, rose, almond and vanilla.

Miniature sets, for trying a whole range: Chloé Women’s Miniature Set (4 x 5ml) (£45.99), Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Set (5 x 4.5ml) (£42.99), Marc Jacobs Daisy and Perfect Miniature Set (£39.99), Dolce & Gabbana Women’s Miniature Set (£39.99) with Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine, The One and Light Blue, and DKNY Delicious Miniature Set (4 x 7ml) (£35.99). Aftershave gift sets for him

  • Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum 100ml + 10ml (£144): bergamot and Sichuan pepper over vanilla and ambroxan. If you only know he likes a fresh, popular scent, this is the safe choice. Our Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum guide explains the versions.
  • Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence 100ml + 15ml (£69.99): juniper, ginger and geranium over clean woods. Crisp and easy to wear every day.
  • Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence 100ml + 15ml (£69.99): citron and calamansi over vetiver, orris and an earthy, resinous base.
  • Bvlgari Man Wood Essence 100ml + 15ml (£64.99): citrus, coriander, cypress and vetiver, a green woody scent.
  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Gift Set (£68.99): a 100ml eau de toilette and two 10ml travel sprays, with bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml + 5ml (£54.99): blood orange, lemon and juniper, then sage and lavender over cedarwood.

For a man who likes to switch, the Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set (£34.99) holds Devotion, K in two versions, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. More in aftershave gift sets for him.

Hermès Miniature Set (4 x 7.5ml) (£64.99) holds four unisex scents from the Jardins collection. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10ml) (£59.99) holds Orange Mauresque, Miel d’Arabie, Jasmin Moghol and Rose Seljuke, and Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo (3 x 12ml) (£44.99) three bright Mediterranean scents. When skin feels tight and dry, a body butter is the richest way to put comfort back. It is thicker than a lotion, melts on contact with warm skin and leaves a soft, cushioned finish. Here is how a body butter differs from a body lotion, which one suits your skin, and how to use it so a little goes a long way.

What is body butter?

A body butter is a thick, rich moisturiser for the body, made mainly from plant butters such as shea butter and cocoa butter. It feels firm in the jar, softens as it warms in your hands and leaves a soft, cushioned layer on the skin. A small amount covers a large area, so one jar lasts a good while.

Body butter vs body lotion: what is the difference?

The difference is mostly water. A body lotion is mainly water with some oils and butters, so it feels light, sinks in fast and suits everyday use. A body butter is made mostly or entirely of plant butters and oils, such as shea butter, cocoa butter and almond oil, so it is richer, takes a little longer to sink in and leaves skin feeling soft for longer. Body creams sit in between.

  • Choose a body butter for very dry or rough skin, for elbows, knees, shins and heels, at night, and in cold weather.
  • Choose a body lotion for a quick morning routine, for warm days, or if you dislike a rich finish.

Many people use both: a lotion in the morning and a butter at night.

Our body butters, compared

Chocolate body butter

Deyga Chocolate Body Butter (£15.99, 100g) is a short, simple blend: cocoa powder, shea butter, almond oil, jojoba oil, cocoa butter and vitamin E, with no water in the ingredient list. The cocoa gives it a light, natural chocolate scent rather than a sweet perfume, which makes this chocolate body butter a favourite for evenings and a lovely small gift.

Rose and geranium body butter

Deyga Rose & Geranium Body Butter (£15.99, 40g) swaps cocoa for floral essential oils: rose and geranium with shea butter, almond oil, jojoba oil and vitamin E. The 40g size is small enough for a handbag, for dry hands and elbows on the go.

A luxury body butter

Highborn London Natural Luminosity Body Butter (£50) comes in a large 220ml glass jar in recyclable packaging, free from parabens and sulphates. Its butter-soft formula is made to smooth over the whole body, and the brand says it can be used on the face too.

Body butter for dry skin: how to use it

  1. Apply after a shower or bath, while skin is still slightly damp. The butter seals in the water on your skin.
  2. Warm a small amount, about the size of a grape for each leg, between your palms until it softens.
  3. Press, then smooth it over the skin in long strokes, rather than rubbing hard.
  4. Add a little more to elbows, knees, shins and heels.
  5. Give it a few minutes to sink in before getting dressed. At night, it can work while you sleep.

Once or twice a week, use a scrub first, such as Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Polish (£22.99) or Deyga Body Scrub (£16.99). On freshly smoothed skin, a body butter spreads further and feels more even. Browse all body scrubs.

Prefer something lighter? Body lotions for dry skin

  • Vilvah Milk Body Lotion (£25.99, 250ml): oat milk, ceramides, olive squalane, coconut and jojoba oils in a vegan formula, made for daily use.

Feet and lips

Deyga Foot Butter (£12.99, 40g) blends virgin coconut oil, olive oil, beeswax, vitamin E and vanilla essential oil; apply it at night and pull on cotton socks. For lips, Highborn London Superior Lip Butter (£22.50) comes in a 15ml size, or a large 50ml. For the softest lips, use a scrub first: see how to use a lip scrub.

Body butter and perfume

Perfume lasts longer on moisturised skin, because there is something for it to hold on to. Smooth an unscented or lightly scented butter over your pulse points before you spray. We explain how in how to layer oud with body butter.

  • Patch test first, especially with butters that contain essential oils, such as rose, geranium or vanilla.
  • Keep it cool. Natural butters soften in warm rooms and firm up in the cold; keep the jar out of direct sun and heat.
  • Not for broken or irritated skin. If your skin is very dry, cracked or itchy for a long time, speak to a pharmacist or your GP.

A body scrub is the quickest way to make skin feel smoother. It buffs away the dry, dull surface layer, so skin feels softer straight away and your body lotion or butter spreads more easily afterwards. But scrubs are not all the same: some are creamy, some are gritty, some are powders you mix yourself. Here is how to choose a body scrub, how to use it and how often.

What does a body scrub do?

A body scrub is a physical exfoliator: small grains, such as sugar, coffee or fine plant powders, gently lift away dead skin cells as you massage. The result is skin that feels smoother and looks more even and fresh. It also makes the next step work better, because a moisturiser goes onto clean, smooth skin rather than a dry, flaky layer.

Which type of body scrub is right for you?

Cream body polish: gentle and quick

A cream polish mixes fine grains into a soft, creamy base, so it cleans and exfoliates at the same time and can replace your shower gel on scrub days. Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Polish (£22.99, 200ml) combines coffee powder and ivory palm seed powder with shea butter, olive oil, argan oil and almond milk extract. It suits most skin types, including dry skin.

Powder scrubs: mix to the texture you like

Powder scrubs come dry; you mix a spoonful with water, rose water or toner into a paste. That makes them easy to adjust: a thicker paste for elbows and knees, a thinner one for softer skin. Deyga Body Scrub (£16.99, 100g) is a blend of dried fruit powders (lemon, papaya, pineapple, pomegranate and bitter orange) with purple rice. For something finer that also works on the face, Deyga Face & Body Exfoliator (£15.99, 50g) blends lemon, neem, matcha and black rice.

A luxury scrub in a jar

Highborn London Natural Luminosity Scrub (£50) is a natural exfoliant in a large 220ml glass jar, free from parabens and sulphates, in recyclable packaging. A good choice for a treat or a gift.

Tools: a loofah

Prefer to use your usual shower gel? A natural loofah such as the Deyga Organic Loofah (£12.99), made from plant fibres and biodegradable, adds gentle exfoliation to every wash.

Coffee body scrub: why it is so popular

A coffee body scrub is one of the most searched types in the UK. Ground coffee gives a satisfying, even texture and a warm, comforting smell that makes scrub day feel like a treat. Look for one in a creamy base with oils or butters, so skin does not feel tight afterwards; the Vilvah Cookie N Cream Body Polish is a good example. Rinse the shower tray afterwards so grounds do not build up in the drain.

How to use a body scrub, step by step

  1. Warm up. Shower or bathe for a few minutes first, so skin is warm and damp.
  2. Take a small amount, about a tablespoon for each arm or leg.
  3. Massage in slow circles with light pressure. Let the grains do the work; you do not need to press hard.
  4. Spend a little longer on rough areas, such as elbows, knees and heels.
  5. Rinse well with warm, not hot, water and pat skin dry.
  6. Moisturise straight away, while skin is still slightly damp.

How often should you use a body scrub?

For most people, once or twice a week is plenty. Dry or sensitive skin may prefer once a week, or a gentler cream polish. Scrubbing every day can leave skin feeling tight or tender, so more is not better. Skip the scrub on skin that is sunburnt, irritated, broken or freshly shaved or waxed; many people scrub the day before hair removal instead.

Body scrub for dry skin: what to use afterwards

If your skin is dry, the step after the scrub matters most. A rich butter locks in moisture on freshly exfoliated skin:

  • Deyga Chocolate Body Butter (£15.99, 100g): cocoa powder, cocoa butter and shea butter with almond and jojoba oils, and a light chocolate scent.
  • Deyga Rose & Geranium Body Butter (£15.99, 40g): shea butter, almond and jojoba oils with rose and geranium essential oils, in a handbag size.
  • Highborn London Natural Luminosity Body Butter (£50), the partner to the Luminosity Scrub, in a 220ml glass jar.
  • Prefer something lighter? Vilvah Milk Body Lotion (£25.99) with oat milk, ceramides and olive squalane.

See all our body butters, and more ideas for dry skin.

Scrub sets

The Vilvah Body Polishing Kit (£48.99) pairs the Cookie N Cream Body Polish with a matching body mask made with kaolin clay, almond milk extract and coffee extract. The Highborn London Scrub and Glow Luminosity Set (£89) puts two Highborn products for face and body together in one box.

Don't forget feet and lips

Feet and lips need their own scrubs: body scrubs are too coarse for lips, and heels usually need a stronger one. For feet, use Deyga Foot Scrub (£17.99) once a week, then Deyga Foot Butter (£12.99) before socks. For lips, a sugar scrub such as Deyga Strawberry Lip Scrub (£10.99) or Vilvah Natural Lip Scrub (£6.99) is all you need; see all lip scrubs and our guide to how to use a lip scrub.

Good to know

  • Keep body scrubs off your face unless the pack says face and body: facial skin is thinner.
  • Keep water out of the jar and use dry hands to scoop, so the scrub stays fresh.
